==============================================================================
Using intelligent tutoring systems for educational purposes
==============================================================================

Abstract:
Intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) are computer programs that are
designed to simulate a human tutor's behaviour when guiding a student.
We review literature on ITS with a particular focus on the educational
purpose of these tools. The review covers 96 articles published between
2010 and 2018 and synthesizes reported effects on learner outcomes,
instructional design choices, and evaluation methods. The analysis
specifically addresses the question of how ITS performance is
transferred to classroom practice and reports mixed evidence for
practice-transfer effects in a typical school deployment.
